---
title: Cache Status
description: Show the cache root, total size, configured TTL, and per-element breakdown for the current repo
---

`ghqc cache status` shows the cache root, total size, configured TTL, and a per-element table for the current repo.

```bash
ghqc cache status
```

## What It Shows

The output is split into two sections:

- `Cache`, showing the cache root, total size on disk, and the configured TTL
- `Repository`, showing the resolved repo, its cache path, and a per-element size and file count table

When run outside a git repository, only the global section is shown.

## Example

```text
── Cache ─────────────────────────────────────
root:     /home/user/.cache/ghqc
size:     1.4 MB (87 files)
ttl:      3600s (default; override with GHQC_CACHE_TIMEOUT)
── Repository ────────────────────────────────
repo:     A2-ai/ghqctoolkit
path:     /home/user/.cache/ghqc/A2-ai/ghqctoolkit

  element          size    files
  -------          ----    -----
  commits      612.4 KB       12
  issues       780.2 KB       64
  users          3.1 KB        2
  labels             —        —
```

## Notes

- The TTL line reflects either the default (3600s) or the value set in `GHQC_CACHE_TIMEOUT`.
- Some elements show `—` when nothing has been cached yet for that element.
